name: M'ONDUNIQ GENEXEM LSEV 100 exosome regenerating serum
shortDescription: Active concentrate containing standardized Lactobacillus (LSEV) exosomes with Matrixyl Synthe'6 peptide, prebiotics and probiotics. The perfect partner for THE FROST cold plasma treatments: after cold plasma, the active ingredients are utilized far more effectively. A ready-made protocol for cold plasma and microneedling. For professional use only.
description:
The M'ONDUNIQ GENEXEM LSEV 100 Exosome Regenerating Serum is a premium-quality, professional active concentrate containing standardized Lactobacillus Extracellular Vesicles (LSEV) exosomes. These microbially derived extracellular vesicles support the skin's natural regeneration processes, help restore the skin barrier and contribute to improved skin comfort.

Most exosome cosmetics available on the market use plant-derived or non-standardized ingredients. In contrast, the raw material of GENEXEM LSEV 100 is produced under laboratory conditions and contains a defined quantity of extracellular vesicles – 100 million vesicles per milliliter – so a reproducible active ingredient of consistent quality is applied to the skin in every treatment.

The advanced mondoceutical formula is especially recommended for the professional treatment of sensitive, irritation-prone, reddened, dehydrated or pigmented skin, or skin showing signs of aging. The product intensively hydrates, reduces redness and supports regeneration, while helping to make the skin more even, firmer and more radiant.

The formula is complemented by the biomimetic peptide Matrixyl Synthe'6, which supports collagen production, improves skin firmness and helps reduce the visibility of fine lines. Hyaluronic acid provides intensive hydration, while beta-glucan and allantoin soothe irritated skin and support its regeneration.

Few professional exosome products combine exosomes with prebiotics and probiotics. Inulin and Lactobacillus Ferment contribute to the balance of the skin microbiome, which is especially important for sensitive skin, after laser and microneedling treatments, and for skin with a damaged barrier or frequent irritation. This combination helps make regeneration not only faster but also more balanced.

The serum was developed to fit today's professional treatments: it is recommended alongside Carbon Peeling, Q-switched ND:YAG treatments, microneedling mesotherapy, nano needling, radiofrequency microneedling and cold plasma treatments, oxygen infusion and ultrasonic active-ingredient delivery alike. After treatments the skin often has an increased need for regeneration – the combination of LSEV exosomes, peptide, hyaluronic acid and soothing active ingredients helps support this natural regeneration process.

Directions: apply the serum to cleansed, dry skin of the face, neck and décolleté. Work it in with gentle massaging movements until fully absorbed. No rinsing required. For professional use only.
